translations.web: He removes the mountains, and they don’t know it, when he overturns them in his anger.
translations.bsb: He moves mountains without their knowledge and overturns them in His anger.
translations.kjv: Which removeth the mountains, and they know not: which overturneth them in his anger.
translations.asv: Him that removeth the mountains, and they know it not, When he overturneth them in his anger;
